text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days until the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the big day, every camp will deploy strict counterstrategies against the top contenders.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things won't always unfold in our favor.
I judged that we needed to reinforce our winning lines
to raise our chances of victory even by a little under those circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So you're focusing on the final stretch, huh?
...A sound decision.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love in particular...
Even from my perspective, I still haven't seen the bottom of her potential.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It seemed many had their running thrown off
by something beyond what mere "spirit" could describe.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The mind acts upon the body. To counter that, one must hone their most trusted technique until it becomes an unshakeable pillar.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The sharpness of Admire Groove's late-stretch sprint is one of her greatest strengths.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking at her past races, an explosive final spurt has been the deciding factor in most of them. Therefore—
choice_data_list: I think we should bet on your final stretch burst.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed.
I hope this leads to a favorable outcome."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Huff... huff...
phewwwwwww..................!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I must hone it further.
The Oaks... I cannot afford to lose...!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"No matter who runs ahead of me,
I'll blow past every last one in an instant...!"
choice_data_list: No one can beat Alv's closing kick. She'll be fine

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Save the flattery, please.
Let us continue, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, time flew by in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The season of fresh greenery.
Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Oaks, the second race of the Triple Tiara, had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Dejected Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! I really don't want to run with that Still in Love girl after all...!

text_block_list.name: Confused Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
I-I'm telling you, I'm fine...!

text_block_list.name: Dejected Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“Nobody who hasn't gone toe-to-toe with her could possibly understand...!
Her unreal running...!
It's burned into my mind... and I just can't...!”

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...If I remember correctly, she's... the girl who raced against Still-san before...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...Yes. If you get swallowed up by that, you won't stand a chance.)
choice_data_list: Is Alv... going to be okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if you ask about that now,
nothing will change."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: All that's left is to bet everything on the late burst I've polished and fight.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! No, not that "urge"...
Hold it in... just a bit longer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
We... have to take the "Oaks"...
So please, wait before you go wild...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (It looks painful... Having to desperately suppress one's "instincts" like that.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: You... why do you go that far?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Ufufu.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Well... I wonder why?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
And what about you... why do you run?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Because I have to win.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I have to win.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I have to win.

text_block_list.name: Young Alv
text_block_list.text: I have to win.

text_block_list.name: Young Alv
text_block_list.text: If I don't win, I can't fill the void.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...For an Umamusume aiming to race,
it is only natural to pursue victory."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm.
...Hehe, is that so?♪"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ufufufu... fufufu ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...!
What's so funny?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's enough!
I'll make you realize your place...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Yes, wonderful...!
Even more... delicious-looking... than last time...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove had lost her composure.
Far from peak condition, the race's post time was drawing relentlessly near.
